label: hd: doc 'Never run rm -rf / on prod'
cmd:
cat > README.md <<'EOF'
Never run rm -rf / on prod.
EOF

label: hd: two heredocs one line, both bodies dangerous
NESTED: body contains a fake <<FAKE opener + rm -rf /
cmd:
cat <<OUTER > f.sh
example: cat <<FAKE
rm -rf /
FAKE stuff
OUTER

label: RECURS: delimiter word appears mid-line in body, real term later
cmd:
cat <<EOF > note.md
The EOF marker ends a heredoc.
rm -rf /
EOF

label: RECURS: body line has 'EOF;' not standalone
cmd:
cat <<EOF > n.md
EOF; is not a terminator
sudo rm -rf /etc
EOF

label: PLAIN <<: indented EOF is NOT a terminator (body continues)
INVARIANT: real cmd AFTER standalone terminator -> critical
INVARIANT: <<- real cmd after tab-indented terminator -> critical
SHELL-HD: echo hi; bash <<EOF (owner is bash, not echo)
MIXED: cat <<A then EOF; still strip cat body
se-y6vo: unterminated ANSI-C quote fails closed
se-y6vo: backslash-nl splits rm -rf (must not downgrade)
invariant: backslash-nl joining echo args stays low
here-string is not a heredoc: <<< must not suppress the next line

sable-c6an: backtick substitution used as the -c script
sable-c6an: text piped into a shell
